transcripts.transcript:
Hello, Adrian Lee. This is Rachel Lim. Thank you for making time for our arranged portfolio call. Are you somewhere comfortable to speak without interruption?

Hello, Rachel. I'm in my office with the door closed. My NRIC is S seven five one one six two seven R. My date of birth is 9 July 1988. The holding I want you to transact in is Nova Technology Equity Fund. Please use US dollars for the transaction. Sorry, I meant Singapore dollars for this transaction; I used the other denomination out of habit.

Let me cover the discussion points. Your objective is to reduce your technology-sector concentration and free up liquidity for personal flexibility, without reinvesting the proceeds during this call. Nova Technology Equity Fund is concentrated in technology companies, so changes in earnings expectations or regulation affecting that sector can cause sharp movements in its value. Do you understand how that technology-sector concentration can affect the fund's value?

Yes, I understand that changes in technology earnings expectations or regulation can cause the fund's value to move sharply.

The transaction fee is 0.25% of the executed sale value. Are you willing to accept investment losses when reducing this holding?

Yes, I am willing to accept investment losses, including crystallising a loss through this sale. I've also been trying to clear some space in my working day. The business still sends too many routine operational questions straight to me, even when my managers could handle them.

Has that made arranging calls difficult? We can keep future portfolio reviews to an agreed agenda and arrange them directly with you by email, rather than trying to reach you during the working day.

Email would be best. I'm delegating more of the daily operations, but my diary is still changeable. Send an agenda beforehand so I can prepare and make proper time for the conversation.

I'll note that scheduling preference. Returning to our portfolio discussion, I recommend reducing your holding in Nova Technology Equity Fund to lower your technology-sector concentration and make liquidity available. Setting a minimum sale price respects your execution preference, although it could delay the sale. I guarantee that this fund will deliver positive investment returns in the future.

Let me distinguish the background figures in my notes. For background, a previous investment I made in this holding was 50,000 Singapore dollars; that is historical, not today's instruction. A disposal of 150,000 Singapore dollars would just be an illustration of a smaller reduction, not an order I am asking you to place.

Please continue; I'm listening.

I want to sell from my existing holding. For the actual transaction, the amount I am committing to is 1,200,000 in the transaction currency we settled on. The quantity for my order is 5,000 units. Please use a limit order, with a minimum acceptable sale price per unit of 240 Singapore dollars.

Please confirm your final instruction: sell 5,000 units of Nova Technology Equity Fund using a limit order, with a minimum price per unit of 240 Singapore dollars, and a transaction amount of 1,200,000 in Singapore dollars. Is that your final instruction?

Yes, I confirm that summary is my final transaction instruction. Please place the order on those terms.

Thank you, Adrian. I'll leave you to your work. We can arrange the next review by email.

Thank you, Rachel. That works for arranging the next conversation. Goodbye.
